title: California Civil Code section 9566 - Condition of recovery on a public works payment bond
claims: Section 9566(a) provides that a claimant does not have a right to recover on a payment bond unless the claimant provided work to the direct contractor either directly or through one or more subcontractors pursuant to a public works contract.
Section 9566(b) provides that nothing in the section affects the stop payment notice rights of, and relative priorities among, design professionals.
